selection: tested density with spanning frequency closest to 0.5; first index breaks ties, NOT an estimate of exact pc

longRun.order: Each empty eligible site grows independently; then at most one uniform whole-grid lightning attempt; then the entire hit 4-neighbor component settles before the next drive. Open boundary. Existing fixed treatments never regrow. Single-fire q/duration are unused.
longRun.random: edgeRandom(seed,1000000+globalDrive,channel,cell); channel 0 growth, 1 lightning coin at cell 0, 2 location at cell 0; independent seed stride 104729; shared external opportunities including misses, no resampling
longRun.statistics: Warmup excluded. Large fire >= ceil(0.1*full grid cells). Repeated burns count as cell-events. Lightning includes misses. Individual events are temporally correlated; no independent-event confidence interval. Paired large-fire-per-drive SE is across independent seeds only.
longRun.replay: First seed only, <=130 sampled post-settlement checkpoints retaining the latest lightning per window; final exact endpoint retained. Phase animation is illustrative, not intra-fire time. At most 256 flame sprites per policy. All logical burns retained in raw records.
longRun.modelScope: DS-inspired extension, not strict original DS scheduling; finite experiment is not proof of self-organized criticality or an estimate of a universal critical value.

scope: Scan and structure use independent-site samples, not a forecast for the workspace. Long run starts from baseline structural sample 0 at the selected density, with NO structural clearing; it separately compares natural versus ideal small-fire suppression. Preview policy is fixed, not a winner selected from these data. All policies and negative results retained. No project edit or file export. Three cards show actual result arrays; chart long trace is first seed, statistics all seeds. Apply remains manual; use density/long export UI to save full raw data.
